items.brief: Robinhood CEO urges U.S. to clear path for tokenized stocks
items.why: Tokenized stocks could enable real-time settlement and 24/7 trading if regulatory hurdles are removed.

items.brief: U.S. accounting board proposes stablecoins as 'cash equivalent'
items.why: Recognition of stablecoins as cash-like assets advances their institutional adoption and regulatory clarity.

items.brief: White House crypto adviser optimistic on stablecoin legislation
items.why: Pending crypto legislation could shape stablecoin regulatory framework.

items.brief: GENIUS Act may unintentionally exempt synthetic stablecoins
items.why: Proposed regulation's wording could create regulatory gaps for non-Treasury-backed stablecoins.

items.brief: Wyoming exits LayerZero, moves state stablecoin to new blockchain
items.why: State-level stablecoin infrastructure shift reflects growing focus on blockchain security for tokenized assets.

items.brief: Kraken offers tokenized and traditional U.S. stocks in Europe
items.why: Blurs TradFi-crypto divide by offering both tokenized and conventional equities on regulated platform.

items.brief: Neuberger, Securitize launch multi-chain tokenized fixed-income fund
items.why: Major asset manager brings tokenized fixed-income strategies across multiple blockchains.

items.brief: Securitize brings Neuberger's fixed-income platform onchain
items.why: Tokenized fixed-income fund expands access to institutional strategies across multiple blockchains.

items.brief: Hong Kong's regulated stablecoin used for insurance and trade settlement
items.why: HKD-pegged stablecoin enables real-world settlement in major trade corridor.

items.brief: Toyota Finance opens tokenized bonds to retail investors via app
items.why: Tokenized bonds democratize fixed-income access and reduce barriers for retail participation.
